Semantic tokens: what analysis knows of the names of a document and a
grammar cannot. Macros by the class the parser gives them, functions
where declared and where called (the file's own, inherited, the auto
object's or the driver's), global and local variables, parameters,
inherit labels, and `function` where the lib has closures. A name
nothing is known of has none, nor have strings, comments and keywords.
All of a document, a range of it, and a delta from the last answer; and
the client is asked to ask again when a change to another file changes
a document's tokens.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
dialect: {closures: true}
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
auto_object = "/sys/auto";
-- lib/include/std.h --
#define BASE "/std/base"
#define status int
#define LIMIT 10
-- lib/sys/auto.c --
void tell(string s) {}
-- lib/std/base.c --
int weight;
int query_weight() { return weight; }
-- lib/obj/a.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit base BASE;

static status heavy(int n) {
    function f;
    int w;
    w = query_weight() + base::query_weight();
    tell("é" + w); f = &heavy();
    ob->query_weight(); nobody();
    return w > LIMIT;
}
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
tokens lib/obj/a.c

# The lines of a range, the first one's line counted from the top.
tokens lib/obj/a.c 6:0-8:0

# A delta: a name that is no longer known, then no change at all.
change lib/obj/a.c 6:8-6:20 "unknown_fn"
delta lib/obj/a.c
delta lib/obj/a.c

# A delta from an answer that is not the last: all of them.
delta lib/obj/a.c 1

# The inherited function is gone: the client is asked to ask again.
write lib/std/base.c "int weight;\n"
watched changed lib/std/base.c
received workspace/semanticTokens/refresh
tokens lib/obj/a.c 6:0-7:0
